advisories.title: Remove the superseded session mock from this action test
advisories.body: The action module now obtains authorization exclusively through the new authorization helpers, but this test still registers and configures a `getSessionUser` mock that no imported action consumes. Removing that obsolete setup makes the test's authorization boundary explicit and avoids a misleading future dependency.
evidence: Premise: __tests__/admin-actions.test.ts:39-43 adds the authorization-module mock, while the existing session mock is only declared/configured at lines 12, 21, 35-37, and 95 → Improvement: eliminates dead test infrastructure and makes the active authorization seam unambiguous → Fix: remove `mockGetSessionUser`, its session-module mock, and its assignment in `authAs`.
rg -n 'getSessionUser|mockGetSessionUser' __tests__/admin-actions.test.ts → all four remaining references are mock setup; no test assertion or imported action uses that mock.
app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:43-45,58-61 → the changed action module delegates its identity checks to `requireAdmin` and `requireCapability`, not `getSessionUser`.

suppressions.candidate: Change pending task status and unchecked acceptance items solely from the current worktree
suppressions.note: The task artifact is a planning and acceptance record; the isolated documentation hunk does not itself establish the full verification evidence required to change its task status.

suppressions.candidate: Split the parameterized required-document checks into one test per field
suppressions.note: The table-driven test identifies every field in failures and remains readable; separate tests would not provide a concrete maintenance benefit.

suppressions.candidate: Replace the inactive-account fixture with a separate shared factory
suppressions.note: The fixture is short and local; a factory would add indirection without a concrete reuse benefit in this file.
